{{Quote|I want a ''Rogue''-class starfighter, with elite weapons, cloaking device, the works. Oh, and triple my usual rate.|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] demand for pulling off a [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|dangerous job]] for Darth Sidious|<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>}}
The '''''Rogue''-class Porax-38 starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] model adapted from the [[Utapau/Legends|Utapauan]] [[Porax-38 starfighter]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:RogueClassFighters-TCWf.png|thumb|left|200px|''Rogue''-class fighters flown by IG-100 MagnaGuards]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to return [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] he appropriated from [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|attacked]] by a pair of ''Rogue''s piloted by [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], who disabled it before being destroyed themselves.<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

Several of these starfighters were stored aboard [[Skytop Station]] prior to its destruction, likely for defense. All ''Rogue''-class starfighters aboard were destroyed with the rest of the station.

[[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] also owned a ''Rogue''. It was heavily modified and was called [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] gave it to Bane as a partial payment for his work on their behalf.

==Behind the scenes==
Although the starfighter seen in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series greatly resembles the Porax-38 starfighter model, it was mentioned as a "''Rogue''-class starfighter" in the episode "[[Holocron Heist]]." The [[2011]] publication ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' eventually [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]ed all of the Porax-38's appearances in ''The Clone Wars'' by identifying the ''Rogue''-class as an entirely different model.
